messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-04T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: GPU runway weekly sync: firming deal-linked commitments

Team —

I’m kicking off this week’s runway sync focused on RDW-4852 (Aurelia Analytics). They’ve signaled a mid-May deployment window and want to lock a dedicated capacity block if we can meet their latency targets. I pulled a draft runway sheet (attached) — please review the ask below and reply with the following by EOD Wed:

- Sales: firm close probability & committed start date (Ben/Karthik)
- Infra: minimum guaranteed GPU count + earliest provision date and any burst options (Marissa)
- Finance: any billing or discount constraints if we guarantee reserved capacity early (Laura)

Attachment: fleet_runway_q2.xlsx (draft: demand rows + provisional pool assignments)

High-level context: Aurelia is proposing a 12-month dedicated pool; initial Q1 usage estimate is 4x A100s sustained (prediction from their eval runs). If they convert early we need to decide whether to carve from our Dedicated pool or open a new reserved slice.

I’ll compile replies into a short decision note for the execs on Friday.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Priya / all —

Quick snapshot from the Aura (Aurelia) opportunity:
- Current forecast: 80% probability for mid-May close (legal + SOC2 review in progress)
- Target start date: 2027-05-20 (customer requests ramp window 2–4 weeks after contract effective date)
- Expected committed pool: 4 A100-equivalent for baseline; 2 additional A100 equiv as burst for peak model retrain jobs (fewer than 8 hours/week).

I attached the live pipeline export: pipeline_snapshot.csv — shows the committed ARR and weighted close dates if you want to cross-check.

If infra needs an earlier anchor, we can consider a soft-commit (term + deposit) instead of full reserved pricing. Will coordinate with legal next 48 hours.

— Ben

Subject: Re: GPU runway weekly sync: firming deal-linked commitments

Adding a little color from discovery: Aurelia will want guarantees around throughput for inference (95th pct latency SLAs) as part of the contract. They may accept a progressive ramp (2 A100s first 30 days, then full 4 A100s) — that would help provisioning.

Question for infra: is progressive ramping something the Dedicated product team can support with automatic scale steps, or do we need explicit pool carve-outs? If progressive works, we can push a later hard start and reduce immediate commit.

Thanks — Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@cloudvendor.io
Date: 2027-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU runway weekly sync: firming deal-linked commitments

FYI — pulled pool numbers and constraints. See attached summary (pool_capacity_report.pdf). TL;DR: current Dedicated pool has a short window in late May where we can shift 4xA100 equiv without impacting committed customers if we accept a 7–10 day lead time for provisioning and final capacity tests.

Notes:
- Progressive ramping: supported via our autoscale + reserved slice model, but we need clear step dates in the contract for capacity gating and billing proration.
- Burst capacity: we can route short retrain jobs to burst (best-effort) pools; however, burst reliability is not SLA-backed. For customers requiring SLA on bursts, we will need to reserve additional capacity.
- Compatibility: some model variants require 80GB memory nodes; if Aurelia picks that path we’ll need to allocate larger instances (reduces the count of physical GPUs available for other pools).

Suggested near-term plan:
1) Commit to a progressive ramp: 2 A100 equiv on 2027-05-20, expand to 4 A100 equiv by 2027-06-01.
2) Mark 2 A100-equivalent for burst (best-effort) and outline that bursts are not SLA-backed unless billed as reserved.
3) Confirm whether Aurelia will need 80GB instances (Ben to confirm during legal/tech-review).

Attachment: pool_capacity_report.pdf
— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU runway weekly sync: firming deal-linked commitments

Thanks for the context. A couple of finance items to flag:

- Pricing model: if we accept a progressive ramp (2 -> 4 GPUs) we should structure billing with an anchor minimum for month 1 and prorated increments thereafter. That avoids under-recovery on our side.
- Early reservation discount: I can provision a 5% early-commit credit if the customer signs a 12-month term and pays a 20% upfront deposit.
- Internal approval: I’ll need a one-page cost impact note showing expected monthly recoveries vs. opportunity ARR before I can approve the discount. Priya, can you collate the draft deal_estimate_v2.xlsx (please attach) and I’ll run numbers by treasury.

Also: if we carve 80GB instances for them, that increases monthly cost by ~18% vs standard A100-equivalent pricing — we should surface that to the customer now.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: GPU runway weekly sync: firming deal-linked commitments — summary & next steps

Thanks all — consolidating next steps here so execs can triage on Friday:

Action items:
- Ben: confirm whether Aurelia intends to use 80GB nodes OR standard A100-equivalents by Thursday EOD (2027-04-08). If 80GB, note will include the 18% uplift.
- Marissa: tentatively reserve pool slice for progressive ramp with provisioning window starting 2027-05-18; confirm any final gating tests needed by 2027-05-10.
- Laura: run the financial recovery note based on Priya’s updated deal_estimate_v2.xlsx (I will attach the draft in a follow-up). Confirm discount approval workflow and the treasury check timeline.
- Priya: assemble decision memo + single-slide summary for Friday 2027-04-09 exec sync.

I’ll attach the updated deal_estimate_v2.xlsx in my follow-up and schedule a short 30-minute call Thursday 9:00am PT if we need a live tie-break.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
